purpose: Every recent handoff lists the Tigris as absent: Mesopotamia receives only Euphrates water, so a Mesopotamian non-inflation test cannot yet be fair. This step qualifies a Tigris gauge on the same source, quality rule and epoch as the existing Hit (Euphrates) gauge, and computes the same flood-phase diagnostic. It does not add Tigris water to any field run.
known: PANGAEA metadata only (not values): RivDIS record 10.1594/PANGAEA.218902, Tigris at 36.32 N 43.15 E (Mosul), 1964-10-15 to 1972-03-15, the same span as Hit (10.1594/PANGAEA.218668); record 10.1594/PANGAEA.218359, Tigris at 33.30 N 44.38 E (Baghdad), 1968-04-15 to 1972-03-15. No Tigris discharge values inspected.
coordination: Parallel to the field-water work on this branch (latest e.g. 3bf6bb2e). New files only; the existing seasonality producer, reviewer, sources and outputs are imported or read, never modified.

sources.reason: Same window as Hit: before Mosul Dam (1986) and the large Turkish Tigris dams. Lake Tharthar diversion (1956) and Dokan (1959, Lesser Zab) lie DOWNSTREAM of Mosul. Earlier local management not assumed absent.
Downstream of the Zab and Adhaim tributaries and of the Tharthar diversion (regulated). Used only if it has at least 5 complete years; otherwise retained as unscored with its exclusions listed.

quality: Identical to calibration/flood_basin_seasonality_20261113: every calendar year needs exactly 12 unique nonnegative finite monthly means; incomplete years are dropped and listed, never filled; at least 5 complete years; complete years pooled equally; m3/s and calendar months kept.
primitive: The same harvest.flood_timing.crop_flood_timing for crop durations 3-9 months and all 12 sowing months; frozen November 5-month illustration reported as for Aswan and Hit.
comparison: Report Mosul beside Hit on the complete years common to both, and on each gauge's own complete years: mean annual flow, peak month, positive-excess volume above the annual mean (the quantity the field runs use as river source), and the November compatibility.
stated_limits: Mosul lies upstream of the Greater Zab, Lesser Zab, Adhaim and Diyala, which add a large share of lower Tigris flow, so a Mosul source understates the water reaching the alluvium. Nothing is scaled to correct this: the understatement is reported. 1964-1972 flows are modern and not a reconstruction of ancient flow.
outputs: Source receipts with hashes; complete-year tables; phase fields and CSV; comparison table; an evidence figure. No field, harvest, population, settlement or atlas default change.
review: Independent raw HTML parse (separately written), complete-year arithmetic, scalar recomputation of the phase primitive and of the excess volumes; fresh byte replay; existing seasonality outputs and protected atlas files unchanged.
next: If the gauge qualifies, declare a Mesopotamia Euphrates-plus-Tigris river pool and the candidate-area policy for Tigris land before any field score; keep the Euphrates-only cases as controls.
